caption: The drawing features three representations of a shoe on a plain, light-colored background. The largest image, positioned in the lower center, is a colored side view of a low-heeled slip-on shoe. This shoe is predominantly gray with subtle shading, has a square toe, and features a gold-colored buckle across the instep. The heel of the shoe is short and colored red. Above this, in the upper left, are two smaller, line-drawn images of the shoe from different perspectives. The left line drawing shows a top-down view, depicting the shape and buckle detail, while the right line drawing shows the outline and seam placement from a different angle, likely the sole or inside view. Both are outlined in thin gray lines with no color fill. The composition leaves ample empty space around the shoes, with all images oriented upright and centered on the page.
title: Man's Shoe
